scenes.context: 蹲姿出片靠侧身与膝盖层次。
sentences: 3个蹲姿通过画面演示，核心是侧身蹲加膝盖高度变化。
Three squat poses, keyed on a side squat plus knee height changes.
side squat（侧身蹲）
蹲姿也能出片，不显矮。
Squatting can still look great and not short.
not look short（不显矮）
scenes.speak: Three squat poses, keyed on a side squat plus knee height changes. Squatting can still look great and not short.

scenes.context: 正面蹲暴露腿厚、缩团显球感。
sentences: 正面蹲会把腿的厚度全部暴露出来。
Frontal squats expose the full thickness of your legs.
expose leg thickness（暴露腿厚）
蹲着时身体缩成一团，下巴贴着膝盖，像球一样。
Curling up with your chin to your knees makes you a ball.
curled like a ball（缩成球）
scenes.speak: Frontal squats expose the full thickness of your legs. Curling up with your chin to your knees makes you a ball.

scenes.title_cn: 正确的蹲姿逻辑：侧身蹲，露出腿部侧面…
scenes.title_en: The right squat: turn sideways to reveal t…
sentences: 侧身蹲，露出腿部侧面线条。
Squat sideways to reveal the leg line.
side line（侧面线条）
通过膝盖的高度变化，制造腿部层次感。
Vary the knee heights to build leg layers.
knee height change（膝盖高度变化）
手搭在膝盖上或自然垂放，形成三角形框架。
Rest a hand on the knee or hang it, forming a triangle frame.
triangle frame（三角框架）
侧身加膝盖高度差，等于纵向线条延长，不会显矮。
Side turn plus knee height difference extends vertical lines—no shorter look.
vertical lines（纵向线条）
scenes.speak: Squat sideways to reveal the leg line. Vary the knee heights to build leg layers. Rest a hand on the knee or hang it, forming a triangle frame. Side turn plus knee height difference extends vertical lines—no shorter look.

sentences: 身体侧向镜头45度，一个膝盖高一个膝盖低，手搭在高的膝盖上。
Body at 45 degrees, one knee high and one low, hand on the high knee.
45-degree template（45度模板）
适合街拍、旅行照、需要低角度构图的场景。
Great for street, travel, and low-angle composition.
low-angle shots（低角度构图）
穿短裙时不适合蹲姿，容易走光。
Avoid squats in short skirts—privacy risk.
privacy risk（走光风险）
scenes.speak: Body at 45 degrees, one knee high and one low, hand on the high knee. Great for street, travel, and low-angle composition. Avoid squats in short skirts—privacy risk.

practice: Squat sideways to reveal the leg line.
Vary one knee high, one low, or crossed.
Rest a hand on the knee to form a triangle.
Body at 45 degrees, hand on the high knee.
pitfalls: Turn sideways to reveal the leg line.
Keep the torso open and tall.
缩成一团下巴贴膝像球。
Keep both knees at the same height.
Vary the knee heights for layers.
Avoid squatting poses in short skirts.
shifts: 用 side squat（侧身蹲）、knee height change（膝盖高度变化）
用 leg line（腿部线条）、vertical lines（纵向线条）、triangle frame（三角框架）
用 layers（层次感）、extended（修长）、photogenic（上镜）
